questiontext.text:
Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a population pyramid ?

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

[[ if test="member(1, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is It has male population of various age groups shown on the positive side and the corresponding female population shown on the negative side of the x-axis.

It has male population of various age groups shown on the positive side and the corresponding female population shown on the negative side of the x-axis" does not represent a characteristic of a typical population pyramid. A population pyramid is a graphical representation of the age and sex distribution of a population.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(2, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is It has life expectancy of the individuals shown on the pyramid.

When a population pyramid includes information about the life expectancy of individuals, it means that the graphical representation not only shows the distribution of age groups but also provides an indication of the average lifespan within that population.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(3, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is It can be used to project population growth.

A population pyramid is a graphical representation of the age and sex distribution of a population at a specific point in time. While it primarily provides a snapshot of the existing population structure, it can also be used to project population growth and make inferences about future demographic trends.

[[/ if ]]
